name: Desktop
description: KDE Plasma 6 workstation desktop, configured (not forked) via upstream Breeze color schemes, a Look-and-Feel package, and /etc/xdg distribution defaults. Package installation and configuration application are not performed by S1 — see docs/desktop/installation-plan.md for what 'implemented' means at this phase.

rollback.notes: No package installation or configuration write is performed by S1; rollback is not applicable yet. See docs/desktop/configuration-ownership.md for the ownership model a future Apply/rollback implementation would rely on.
